causal_change.after: The champion's witness, fixed preimage, first-discontinuity trigger and reachable-domain admission, linear corridor semantics, direct-edge custody, and every ordinary stop remain unchanged. At only the first source-grounded acyclic non-nested single-entry/single-exit fork reached while the sole carrier is active, when every fixed branch preserves the same obligation and a unique merge postdominates the fork, the carrier may transition from ACTIVE_LINEAR to one RENDEZVOUS_WAIT state instead of terminating. All qualification evidence and the final action are consequences of this one carrier-state factor. The proposal does not widen the champion's linear corridor, change relation admission, alter nodes or edges, synthesize alternatives, or assign separate agents to branches; it adds exactly one event-driven state transition and decision path for the single existing carrier.
